capabilities: Add a context menu for local images with copy, save as, rename, delete, and reveal in Finder or file tree
Add a context menu for remote images with copy, save as, and download-and-replace
Run batch image operations from the command palette, such as converting or removing unused images
Preview HEIF/HEIC images without extra steps
extras: README warns the plugin is in active development and may have bugs; many listed features (batch commands, HEIF/HEIC preview, upload-to-remote) are marked [WIP] or unchecked TODOs, so current functionality is mostly the two context menus.
motivation: The author built it because daily image handling in Obsidian was inconvenient: sparse context menus, no menu for local images, and no easy way to convert images between local and remote.
problem: Obsidian's context menu options for remote images are limited, local images have no context menu, and copying, renaming, or deleting images referenced in the current file requires manual work.
summary: Image utility plugin that adds right-click context menus and batch commands for managing local and remote images in notes.
